rounds.text: The evidence provided strongly supports the argument that Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd (RBA) is being underappreciated by the market. [E6] indicates a P/B ratio of 2.95x against a sector benchmark of 4.48x, suggesting RBA's stock is undervalued relative to its peers. Additionally, [E28] shows that the company has seen an improvement in quarterly operating margins from 15% in the year-ago quarter to 17% in Mar 2026, indicating potential for future growth and profitability. These factors combined suggest that RBA's stock is currently trading below its fair value, making it a compelling investment opportunity.
